name: Stonesplinter Valley
summary: Stonesplinter troggs have fortified a mountain vale in southwestern Loch Modan. Their chieftain, Grawmug, leads the tribe from the valley.

sections.title: A Chittering Stronghold
sections.body: Stonesplinter Valley lies among the crags of southwestern Loch Modan. Troggs clawed up from underground across Khaz Modan, ending the quiet that once filled the hollow. The Stonesplinter tribe claimed the valley and carved crude defenses into its rocky passes, digging dens and raising barricades. They hunt anything that comes too close. Their numbers threaten the roads through southern Loch Modan, and Mountaineers from Thelsamar hire mercenaries to thin their ranks and bring down Grawmug, the towering warlord who leads them.

faq.answer: Stonesplinter Valley lies in the mountains of southwestern Loch Modan, just south of the main road past Grizzlepaw Ridge.
Grawmug rules the encampment as its brutish trogg chieftain. He directs raids on local travelers and patrols from the deepest part of the valley.

faq.q: Why are the troggs here in Loch Modan?
aliases: why are there troggs in loch modan
where did the troggs come from
faq.answer: Dwarven excavations elsewhere in Khaz Modan unearthed troggs from deep underground. Driven by senseless aggression, separate warbands came to the surface, and the Stonesplinter tribe chose this secluded vale as its main staging ground.

faq.q: Why do the dwarves care about clearing the valley?
faq.answer: The valley lies dangerously close to dwarf settlements, mines, and mountain roads. If the entrenched Stonesplinter troggs go unchecked, travelers in southern Loch Modan face danger and Mountaineer patrols face added strain.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can help the Mountaineers of Thelsamar push back the troggs and drive Grawmug's brutes from Loch Modan.
As an Alliance member, you can help secure Loch Modan's supply routes, now vulnerable while Ironforge forces are stretched thin across the realm.
